resources.string: Asks every source at once and takes word-by-word over line-by-line over unsynced lyrics. If two are equal, the one higher in the list wins
Apple Music lyrics, word by word. Best for English and other Western pop
Apple Music\'s own lyrics, word by word. Huge Western catalog
The largest lyrics catalog, often word by word. Almost every language
Community word-by-word lyrics (YouLy+, BiniLyrics). Mostly popular songs
Apple-style word-by-word archive, matched by recording code. Popular songs
From the BetterLyrics developer, gathers lyrics from several sources
Spotify\'s lyrics, line by line. Wide coverage of current music
Free open database, line by line. Good for English and indie songs
Community lyrics matched to the exact YouTube video. Finds what others miss
Often word by word. Best for Chinese, Japanese and Korean songs
BetterLyrics\' QQ Music route, word by word. Good for Asian songs
Line by line. Good for Chinese and other Asian songs
Line by line. Strong for C-pop, J-pop and K-pop
The lyrics YouTube Music shows. Usually not synced
The video\'s subtitles, line by line
Speech-recognition captions. Often wrong, a last resort. Off by default
